ayahs.en: May the hands of Abu Lahab be ruined, and ruined is he
ayahs.e2: May the hands of Abu Lahab perish, and he ˹himself˺ perish
ayahs.tr: Tab bat yadaa abee Lahabinw-wa tabb

ayahs.ar: مَآ أَغۡنَىٰ عَنۡهُ مَالُهُۥ وَمَا كَسَبَ
ayahs.en: His wealth will not avail him or that which he gained
ayahs.e2: Neither his wealth nor ˹worldly˺ gains will benefit him
ayahs.tr: Maa aghna 'anhu maaluhu wa ma kasab

ayahs.en: He will [enter to] burn in a Fire of [blazing] flame
ayahs.e2: He will burn in a flaming Fire
ayahs.tr: Sa yas laa naran zaata lahab

ayahs.en: And his wife [as well] - the carrier of firewood
ayahs.e2: and ˹so will˺ his wife, the carrier of ˹thorny˺ kindling

ayahs.en: Around her neck is a rope of [twisted] fiber
ayahs.e2: around her neck will be a rope of palm-fibre
